title: Geology and ground water of the Savannah River Plant and vicinity, South Carolina
citation: Siple, G.E., 1967, Geology and ground water of the Savannah River Plant and vicinity, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Water-Supply Paper 1841, map scale 1:125,000.
notes:
USGS Water-Supply Paper 1841 (Siple, 1967), packet 1 (plates and pages 1-46): units from Table 2 with thicknesses from the text, type well 52-C partial log, Table 3 pumping-test results (well observed; the pumped well and rows with garbled cells are omitted; T in gpd per ft, permeability in gpd per sq ft), Plate 5 structure contours on top of Tuscaloosa (labels not itemized) and the October 1954 piezometric map. Table 1 precipitation not recorded. SUBSURFACE: well 52-C log 290-385 ft; contours not itemized.
Packet 2 (pages 47-93): thickness statements for Claiborne deposits, Barnwell, Hawthorn, upland gravels and alluvium; Table 5 pumping test (only the legible row 26 CY; rows 10TCA and 14TSC are garbled in OCR and skipped); Table 4 stream discharge (surface water) and hydrographs not recorded. SUBSURFACE: none beyond thicknesses.
Packet 3 (pages 94-126): Table 7 radiochemical analyses (beta-gamma non-detects recorded with qualifier '<' and the printed limit; radium values as printed, confirmed by the text for samples 2 and 7; row for AK-146 garbled and skipped). Table 6 (range and median for the whole area) and Table 8 clay minerals not recorded; Tables 9-15 are computed drawdowns and well losses (not recorded). Reference list not itemized. SUBSURFACE: none.
